answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured through a stake-slashing matrix mechanism that penalizes malicious agents, rendering it economically unviable to forge identities and participate in the network, thereby preventing the shale of false identities, while incentivizing honest agents to wander freely, without fear of reprisal, thereby fostering a robust and resilient Byzantine Fault Tolerant system.
